Population increased in West Sussex

The estimated population of West Sussex in 2024 was 915,037 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of West Sussex increased by 3.4%.

Age profile of West Sussex

The average (median) age stayed at 44.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of West Sussex has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, West Sussex's population of 915,037 usual residents was made up of:

  • 160,665 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.6%)
  • 541,474 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.2%)
  • 212,898 people aged 65 years and over, (23.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, West Sussex has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In West Sussex, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in West Sussex
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for West Sussex, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,989 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 7,713 births and 9,702 deaths in West Sussex.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 6,699 (0.7%). There were 41,186 people entering the area and 34,487 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in West Sussex's population of 6,326 (0.7%) as a result of 10,129 people entering the area and 3,803 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for West Sussex was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of West Sussex in mid-2023 is 904,033.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,626 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 545 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,171 people.
